messages:
Leah Turner: Quick flag : final-week push starts now. Were focusing on two things: 1) manager handbacks completed within 48h and 2) clearing any forms missing attachments. Please read.

Marcus Green: Got it. Are there automated nudges for ICs who havent attached self-assessments?

People Ops Bot: automated-reminder: Were sending daily nudges at 09:00 local to employees with missing items and a second reminder at 18:00. Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/final-week-checklist

Jillian Park: Small ask : can managers mark a report as "pending evidence" to avoid accidental handbacks?

Leah Turner: Yes. Adding a "pending evidence" flag that prevents handback until cleared. Managers can mark it in the dashboard or use this CSV bulk:```csv
employee_email,flag,notes
sam.khan@redwood.ai,pending_evidence,uploading artifacts
```

Marcus Green: Whats the escalation if we hit >8% missing attachments org-wide?

Leah Turner: If >8% missing, People Ops will start a targeted email campaign and open a temporary "forms help" drop-in (6 hours across PST/EST/EU). Well also enable an extended 48-hour grace for affected teams only.

Review Ops Bot: note: Reassignments for overdue manager handbacks will occur automatically after 72h; first attempt is to route to the manager's backup reviewer. See conflict rules: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/conflicts

Jillian Park: Can we get a one-click export of missing-attachments per manager? Saves time chasing.

People Ops Bot: update: added "export missing-attachments" button to manager dashboard. Exports include employee_email, missing_items, last_reminder_ts. CSV sample:```csv
employee_email,missing_items,last_reminder_ts
lee.huang@redwood.ai,self-assessment,2112345600
```

Marcus Green: Any guidance for managers traveling this week? Im out Thu-Fri.

Leah Turner: Please designate a backup via the quick form: https://forms.redwood.com/backup-delegate or add the CSV below and DM me. Backups must not be direct managers.

Marcus Green: Uploading backup now. Thanks.

Leah Turner: Final note : well post hourly status updates in #people-ops during the push window. If your team needs an org-specific extension, ping me with a short rationale and a proposed deadline. Appreciate the hustle everyone. :rocket:
